title: Crochet Sun Catcher
name: Sun Catcher
seoTitle: Crochet Sun Catcher Pattern on a Bangle (Free PDF)
description: Free crochet sun catcher pattern worked around an old bangle: three colours, a picot edge and a scalloped border. Printable PDF and round-by-round steps.
lead: An old bangle becomes a sunny wall hanging. You crochet around the bangle, add a little white picot edge, then a yellow round and a white scalloped border. Hang it in a window with a bead at the bottom.
yarn: Cotton yarn in a main colour, white and yellow

materialsTable.details: Cotton yarn in a main colour, white and yellow
One bangle or metal ring (any size)
One bead for the hanging loop

notes: The stitch counts are for 48 sc around the bangle. For a bigger bangle use any multiple of 3.
Round 2 uses the front loops of round 1 and round 3 uses the back loops, so both colours sit on the same base round.

rounds.text: With the main colour: work 48 sc around the bangle. sl st into the front loop of the first st.
ch 2, sc in the front loop of each st around (FLO). sl st into the first st and fasten off.
Join white in any st. (ch 3, skip 1 st, sl st in the next st) around. sl st, ch 1 and fasten off.
Join yellow in a back loop of round 1. ch 1, dc in the back loop of each st around (BLO).
(ch 4, skip 2 sts, sc in the next st) around.
Join white in a ch-4 space. (6 sc in the ch-4 space, sl st into the next sc) around. Fasten off.
ch 44. Attach both ends to the top of the sun catcher to make a loop. Add a bead at the bottom.

finishing: Weave in all the ends on the back.
Hang it in a sunny window.
